texts.label: text
texts.orig: A DECREE INSTITUTING A WATER CODE, THEREBY REVISING AND CONSOLIDATING THE LAWS GOVERNING THE OWNERSHIP, APPROPRIATION, UTILIZATION, EXPLOITATION, DEVELOPMENT, CONSERVATION AND PROTECTION OF WATER RESOURCES
texts.text: A DECREE INSTITUTING A WATER CODE, THEREBY REVISING AND CONSOLIDATING THE LAWS GOVERNING THE OWNERSHIP, APPROPRIATION, UTILIZATION, EXPLOITATION, DEVELOPMENT, CONSERVATION AND PROTECTION OF WATER RESOURCES

texts.label: text
texts.orig: WHEREAS, Article XIV, Section 8 of the New Constitution of the Philippines provides, inter alia, that all waters of the Philippines belong to the State;
texts.text: WHEREAS, Article XIV, Section 8 of the New Constitution of the Philippines provides, inter alia, that all waters of the Philippines belong to the State;

texts.label: text
texts.orig: WHEREAS, existing water legislations are piece-meal and inadequate to cope with increasing scarcity of water and changing patterns of water use;
texts.text: WHEREAS, existing water legislations are piece-meal and inadequate to cope with increasing scarcity of water and changing patterns of water use;

texts.label: text
texts.orig: WHEREAS, there is a need for a Water Code based on rational concepts of integrated and multipurpose management of water resources and su=ciently Xexible to adequately meet future developments;
texts.text: WHEREAS, there is a need for a Water Code based on rational concepts of integrated and multipurpose management of water resources and su=ciently Xexible to adequately meet future developments;

texts.label: text
texts.orig: WHEREAS, water is vital to national development and it has become increasingly necessary for government to intervene actively in improving the management of water resources;
texts.text: WHEREAS, water is vital to national development and it has become increasingly necessary for government to intervene actively in improving the management of water resources;

texts.label: text
texts.orig: NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in me vested by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree the enactment of the Water Code of the Philippines of 1976, as follows:
texts.text: NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in me vested by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree the enactment of the Water Code of the Philippines of 1976, as follows:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: ARTICLE 1. This Code shall be known as The Water Code of the Philippines.
texts.text: ARTICLE 1. This Code shall be known as The Water Code of the Philippines.
